title: Lead guards refuse only the reading part of a Bash call
body:
Outcome: lead-file-read refuses only the over-long reading segment (or truncates its output) instead of the whole Bash call, and an unbounded rg gets a bounded form. Why: scripts/claude/lead-file-read.ts:117-118 refuses every rg without a limit; :158 'Nothing in this Bash call ran' drops the other commands, forcing retries. Proof: hook tests for a compound call with one long read. Scope: scripts/claude/lead-file-read.ts, scripts/claude/bash-guards.ts, tests.
Evidence: .krn/runs/qwen-research/report.md (Qwen 4 audit) verified by krn-reader against HEAD 8152cee.
